notes.title: Overfitting
notes.text: A model can fit training examples too closely and perform poorly on new cases.

notes.title: Embeddings
notes.text: Embeddings represent items as numerical vectors. Nearby vectors can indicate similar meaning in a suitable embedding space.

notes.title: Train-validation splits
notes.text: Keep validation data separate from training data when choosing model settings. Reserve a test set for final evaluation.

notes.title: Gradient descent
notes.text: Gradient descent updates parameters opposite the gradient. A sufficiently small step can reduce a smooth loss locally.

notes.title: Features and labels
notes.text: Features are inputs to a model. Labels are the target values used in supervised training.

notes.title: Matrix multiplication
notes.text: Matrix multiplication combines rows and columns with dot products. The inner dimensions must match.

notes.title: Backpropagation
notes.text: Backpropagation applies the chain rule to compute gradients of a loss through a computation graph.
